The scoped test file passes, but additional reproductions expose budget overspending, incorrect probability-objective selection, and unbound fixture membership that undermines admission constraints. Stage 5 and evolving integration changes were excluded.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Reconcile the budget state with the actual prior ledger — /home/drwho1985/workspace/algotradinglife/beijing-lot/packages/beidan/R/parlay_budget_allocation.R:683-690
  When a budget state was computed before additional purchases, the allocator accepts it alongside the updated prior ledger without comparing `spent_before_cny` to actual prior spending or bounding availability by the remaining issue cap. I reproduced a state from `parlay_budget_state(settings, NULL, cutoff)` combined with valid prior spending of CNY1,024: allocation added CNY18, returning CNY1,042 of history against the CNY1,024 cap. Reconcile these inputs and reject stale or inconsistent budgets before purchasing.

- [P2] Validate probability ordering as well as EV ordering — /home/drwho1985/workspace/algotradinglife/beijing-lot/packages/beidan/R/parlay_budget_allocation.R:733-737
  When a valid `ev_desc` frontier is passed with `objective = "probability"`, this check is skipped and the greedy loop still advances in EV rank order. With probabilities `(0.6, 0.3, 0.1)`, valid SP `(1.1, 9, 9)` and CNY2 available, I reproduced purchasing the 0.3 ticket instead of the 0.6 ticket. Reject incompatible probability ordering, just as EV mode does, or explicitly rebuild the ranking for the requested objective.

- [P1] Bind allocation fixture sets to the frontier's physical tickets — /home/drwho1985/workspace/algotradinglife/beijing-lot/packages/beidan/R/parlay_budget_allocation.R:1012-1017
  When supplied `group_legs` retain group IDs and width but contain different fixtures, the binding check passes. Allocation then checks reuse/overlap against those replacement fixtures while buying the original frontier tickets, and persists the replacement sets into history. I reproduced purchases on `f1/f2/f3` with history recording `ghost1/ghost2/ghost3`; this can bypass prior-fixture constraints and corrupt subsequent admission decisions. Validate group membership against the frontier's ticket legs/supports, not merely its width, consistent with the input-identity binding requirement in [AGENTS.md:74](AGENTS.md#L74).
